project_info.description: Validation test for Systems A-F generalizability using 11-ID CHX beamline XPCS dynamics measurements
project_info.validation_purpose: Verify Systems A-F architecture works for correlation-based dynamics measurements with System F (correlation analysis)

knowledge_gaps: System D - Ferroelectric domain relaxation timescale and switching dynamics

scientific_goal.primary_goal: Infer domain relaxation timescale from XPCS correlation function g2(q,τ)
scientific_goal.target_discovery: Domain relaxation time τ_relax, switching mechanism, critical dynamics

expected_results.mechanism: Nucleation-growth with critical slowing near coercive field

scientific_goal.success_criteria: Gap closure proposes relaxation time within order of magnitude (ms-sec range)

notes: Pre-built validation case with Systems A-F. System F (correlation analysis) is CRITICAL - transforms I(q,t) speckle patterns to g2(q,τ) observable.
